title: Revisiting Equity-Bond Diversification under Tail Risk and Structural Market Change: Evidence from Global ETFs and Model-Implied Option Prices
abstract: arXiv:2611.21897v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This study examines thirty equity--bond and multi-asset exchange-traded funds (ETFs) listed in the United States, Canada, and Australia using daily U.S.-dollar returns over 2020--2024. A rolling-window framework compares minimum-variance and Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) portfolio optimization under long-only and long--short constraints against an equally weighted benchmark. Performance is assessed using risk-adjusted measures, downside risk, extreme-tail estimation, and conditional volatility models. Optimized portfolios exhibit lower empirical VaR and CVaR than the benchmark, with long--short strategies generally providing greater downside-risk reduction. However, the equally weighted benchmark achieves the highest reported Sharpe, Sortino, and Rachev ratios. GARCH and FIGARCH comparisons favor GARCH based on information criteria. translated_title: 尾部风险与市场结构性变化下的股票-债券多元化再审视：来自全球ETF与模型隐含期权价格的证据
translated_abstract: 本研究使用2020至2024年期间的美元计价日收益率，考察了在美国、加拿大和澳大利亚上市的三十只股票-债券及多资产交易所交易基金（ETF）。研究采用滚动窗口框架，在仅做多与多空两种约束条件下，将最小方差和条件风险价值（CVaR）投资组合优化与等权重基准进行比较。绩效评估采用风险调整指标、下行风险、极端尾部估计以及条件波动率模型。结果显示，优化后的投资组合表现出比基准更低的实证VaR和CVaR，其中多空策略通常能带来更大的下行风险降低效果。然而，等权重基准却实现了最高的Sharpe、Sortino和Rachev比率。基于信息准则，GARCH与FIGARCH的比较结果更倾向于GARCH模型。研究还利用历史估计的正态逆高斯模型生成欧式期权价格并……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究对全球30只股票-债券及多资产ETF进行滚动窗口下的最小方差与CVaR组合优化，发现优化组合（尤其多空策略）虽能显著降低尾部与下行风险，但等权重基准的风险调整收益反而最高，揭示了尾部风险管控与收益表现之间的权衡。
en_tdlr: Applying rolling-window minimum-variance and CVaR optimization to 30 global equity-bond and multi-asset ETFs, this study finds that optimized portfolios—especially long-short strategies—reduce tail and downside risk, yet the equally weighted benchmark still achieves the best risk-adjusted returns, highlighting a trade-off between tail-risk control and performance.
